unlisted_practices: Deploying locally hosted open-source LLMs on institutional hardware to extract structured data from clinical free text while keeping patient data private
Comparing prompt engineering approaches (zero-shot vs one-shot) and model sizes for clinical information extraction

screen.reason: The study evaluates the technical performance and prompt engineering of locally hosted Llama 2 models for information extraction on retrospective MIMIC-IV notes against expert ground truth, without evaluating an organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
